summary: Tested hands-free auto-trading + always-visible paper panel (backend pytest + frontend Playwright). Backend 7/7 pass: GET /api/autotrade shape (config+state+open_auto_trade), toggle off->on opens an AUTO paper trade when Brain=LONG/SHORT, no-duplicate-on-retoggle rule, manual trade has source=MANUAL and coexists, trades persist across GETs with source column, /api/paper/stats shape. Frontend validated on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: paper-panel renders below the 10 TA agents (always visible), no header 'Paper' button, autotrade-toggle reads ON by default and flips ON<->OFF via PUT /api/autotrade, autotrade-status line shows 'Engine: running · TF 15m · size $1,000 · last: HOLD LONG (…)', an AUTO trade appears in Open Positions tab tagged AUTO with entry/SL/TP/unrealized PnL, manual New Trade flow creates a MANUAL trade that appears in Open Positions, History tab lists closed trades, stats bar and total realized PnL populate, BTC WS ticker updates ($79,070.1), timeframe switching (15m/1h) works, 10 agent cards render, no runtime error overlay.

issues: data-testid='brain-hero' not present on the Brain hero container (visual content renders correctly, but the testid is missing making automated regression harder). Every other referenced testid was found.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='brain-hero' to the Brain decision hero container (task references it implicitly under 'Brain hero + 10 agent cards render').
Consider mapping paper endpoint failure paths to proper HTTP status codes (still applies from prior iteration: no_price_available / trade_not_found return 200 with error dicts).
critical_code_review_comments: autotrader.update() correctly force-evaluates on off->on transition; one-AUTO-position rule enforced via _open_auto() scan of OPEN trades.
paper_trading.open_trade() uses explicit-column INSERT including source, and ALTER TABLE migration is guarded — safe for existing DBs.
manager._autotrade_loop() polls every 5s and evaluate() is new-candle-gated (last_candle_ts) so it won't spam trades on WS ticks — good.
SL/TP derived from 14-period ATR with fallback price*0.005 when ATR<=0 — reasonable guard.
Single shared sqlite connection with check_same_thread=False + RLock: acceptable now, but recommend per-thread or aiosqlite as concurrency grows.
server.py /api/paper/close/{id} and /api/paper/open still return dicts with 'error' key at 200; prefer HTTPException(400/404) for API consistency.
seed_data_creation: Test opened 1 MANUAL paper trade ($100 LONG, 1% SL / 2% TP) that was left in Open (test does not force-close it). Auto-trade engine also opened AUTO trades during off->on toggling. History table shows accumulated closed trades from prior iterations; safe to purge for a clean demo.
